import datetime,json,os,subprocess,time
from pathlib import Path
root=Path("/outputs/training-acceptance"); root.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
status=root/"driver-status.json"
started=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(); timer=time.monotonic()
record={"status":"running","started_utc":started,"profile":"smoke","scope":"execution acceptance, not convergence","command":["bash","scripts/research/run_training_acceptance.sh"]}
status.write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2)+"\n")
with (root/"driver.log").open("w") as log:
 result=subprocess.run(record["command"],cwd="/workspace/php_parkour",env=os.environ|{"PHP_ACCEPTANCE_OUTPUT":str(root),"NGPUS":"1"},stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
record.update(status="passed" if result.returncode==0 else "failed",returncode=result.returncode,finished_utc=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),elapsed_seconds=time.monotonic()-timer)
status.write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2)+"\n")
raise SystemExit(result.returncode)
